title: 2.3 Classification of Physical Quantities
description: Classification of Physical Quantities concepts and applications. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which pair correctly matches a derived quantity with its unit?
Which pair correctly matches work with its unit?
Which quantity-unit pair is correct?
A car is described as moving at 50 km/h to the east. Which classification is accurate?
options: Velocity is a vector because direction is given
Speed is a vector in this topic in the textbook
Distance is a vector in physics in the textbook
Time is a vector in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Velocity is a vector because direction is given

questions.question: Which statement about area is accurate?
options: It is derived by multiplying length and width
It is a fundamental quantity now for students
It has direction for students in the textbook
It is measured in meters here in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: It is derived by multiplying length and width

questions.question: Which set contains only derived quantities?
options: Area, volume, density and speed now
Length, mass and time in this topic
Candela, kelvin and ampere in class
questions.correctAnswer: Area, volume, density and speed now

questions.question: Which set contains only fundamental quantities?
options: Length, mass, time and temperature now
Speed, force and work now for students
Area, volume and pressure for students
questions.correctAnswer: Length, mass, time and temperature now

questions.question: Which statement about a scalar quantity is accurate?
options: It is fully described by magnitude alone
It requires a direction now for students
It always has negative values in physics
It is measured in newtons in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: It is fully described by magnitude alone

questions.question: Which statement about a vector quantity is accurate?
options: It has both magnitude and direction
It cannot be represented by an arrow
questions.correctAnswer: It has both magnitude and direction

questions.question: Which derived unit can be written as kilogram meter per second squared?
Which derived unit can be written as kilogram meter squared per second squared?
How is pressure expressed in base units?
options: Kilogram meter per second as well
Kilogram per cubic meter in class
Meter squared per second in class

questions.question: Which quantity pairs both have the same unit?
options: Mass and force in the textbook

questions.question: Which list places speed, velocity and acceleration correctly?
options: Speed is scalar; velocity and acceleration are vectors
All three are scalars now for students in the textbook
All three are vectors now for students in the textbook
Speed and acceleration are vectors now in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Speed is scalar; velocity and acceleration are vectors

questions.question: Which quantity is correctly paired with its symbol?
A student says temperature is derived from length. Which correction is accurate?
options: Temperature is derived from mass here
Temperature has no unit in this topic
Temperature is a vector in this topic

questions.question: Which quantity is obtained from force multiplied by displacement?
Which quantity is obtained from displacement divided by time?
Which quantity is obtained from change in velocity divided by time?
Which unit symbol is written as cd?
